definitions.explanation: Describes something that is firmly entrenched and difficult to change or eliminate. Used for beliefs, customs, support, popularity, and prejudices that endure over time.

examples.japanese: {根強|ねづよ}い⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{偏見|へんけん}→偏見：06025_henken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{根強|ねづよ}く⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: That prejudice still persists deeply even now.

examples.japanese: ⟦{反対|はんたい}{派|は}→反対派：30532_hantaiha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{根強|ねづよ}い⟦{抵抗|ていこう}→抵抗：03540_teikou⟧にもかかわらず、⟦{法案|ほうあん}→法案：09758_houan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{可決|かけつ}→可決：00148_kaketsu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Despite persistent opposition from dissenters, the bill was passed.

notes:
FORMS:
- Predicate: {根強|ねづよ}い
- Adverbial: {根強|ねづよ}く (e.g., {根強|ねづよ}く⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧ — to persist deeply)
- Modifier: {根強|ねづよ}い + noun

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {根強|ねづよ}い⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧: enduring popularity
- {根強|ねづよ}い⟦{支持|しじ}→支持：12933_shiji⟧: firm/deep-rooted support
- {根強|ねづよ}い⟦{反対|はんたい}→反対：01497_hantai⟧: persistent opposition
- {根強|ねづよ}い⟦{偏見|へんけん}→偏見：06025_henken⟧: deep-seated prejudice
- {根強|ねづよ}く⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧: to persist tenaciously

USAGE:
Almost always used for abstract things (beliefs, attitudes, support) rather than physical objects. It carries a nuance of being stubbornly entrenched, which can be positive (enduring popularity) or negative (persistent prejudice).
